column1: # Copy to holdings.csv (gitignored — stays on your computer) and put your own buys in. One row per buy.
# Company name or NSE symbol both work. Your broker's holdings export works too (no dates → P&L only).
# WITH a date  → qty and price AS YOU BOUGHT THEM (contract note); splits / bonuses since are applied for you
#                e.g. 100 @ 500 bought before a 1:5 split shows as 500 @ 100.
# WITHOUT date → what your broker shows TODAY (qty and average price). Don't put today's numbers with an old date.
# A company that merged into another? Put the OLD company as you bought it — it's converted.
